name: Hatach
bio: Hatach, one of King Ahasuerus's chamberlains assigned to attend Queen Esther, carried messages between her and Mordecai after Haman's decree against the Jews, relaying Mordecai's account of the plot and Esther's hesitation to approach the king unsummoned, until she resolved to risk her life for her people (Esther 4:5-12).
